title: Mars Bar Krispie Treats
style: No-bake puffed rice bars set with melted Mars bars and a chocolate top.
description: No-bake squares of puffed rice bound with melted Mars bars and butter, topped with a layer of milk chocolate. Makes sixteen 2-inch squares.
steps: Melt the Mars bars and 75 g butter together in a double boiler, stirring until smooth.
Mix in the puffed rice until well combined. Spread into an 8×8-inch tin and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Melt the milk chocolate and 30 g butter together. Spread over the krispie base and return to the fridge for 30 minutes.
Remove from the fridge and cut into squares.
tips: The Mars bars melt more evenly if you chop them first; keep the heat gentle so the caramel doesn't seize.
Line the tin with parchment, leaving an overhang, so you can lift the whole slab out before cutting.
Let the bars sit for a couple of minutes at room temperature before slicing so the chocolate top doesn't crack.
Warm the knife under hot water and wipe between cuts for clean edges.
